objective: Give the events API a paginated, filterable game list and a game detail with both teams, the line score and the full box score per team, built from the EVENTS-004 tables, so the live database can hold every season without GET /events/games returning all of them at once.
acceptance_criteria: GET /events/games returns at most `limit` games (default 50, at most 200), after skipping `offset`, newest first, ordered by date then id descending so that consecutive pages never overlap or skip a game; the response is still a JSON list of GameOut.
GET /events/games filters by `season`, `team_id` (home or away), `game_type` and `date_from`/`date_to` (inclusive calendar dates of the game's stored date), each optional, all combined with AND.
A malformed season, an unknown game_type, a limit outside 1-200, a negative offset, or a date_from later than date_to is answered 422, never an empty list.

GET /events/games/{game_id} returns a GameDetailOut: id, nba_game_id, date, season, game_type, label, sub_label, series_game_number, venue, both final scores, and the home and away teams embedded with id, name and abbreviation; an unknown id is a 404.
The detail carries each team's line score as stored (quarters then overtimes, or null when the game has none), on that team's side.

The detail carries a box score per team: the players who played, starters first and then by seconds played, most first, each with player id, first and last name, starting position, seconds played, every counting stat, and field-goal, three-point and free-throw percentages computed from made and attempted (null when none were attempted); and the players who did not play, each with player id, names and the reason.
Each team's box score carries totals summed from its played rows, with percentages computed the same way; the totals are never adjusted to match the final score.
A game with no box-score rows is answered 200 with empty player lists, zero totals and null percentages.
The detail is built in a fixed number of database queries whatever the size of its box score, never one per player.
GameOut, GET /search/games and the frontend's existing GET /events/games call keep working unchanged, and openapi.json and schema.d.ts match the backend.
